_doc: What a bot picks up after a kill (Loot.SppBots.js): rules in order, the first that matches decides ('take' true or false); nothing matched is left. 'match' (all given must hold): 'items' ItemIds keys, 'names' patterns on the item's name (case-insensitive), 'kinds' (coins, runes, ammo = the ammo the bot wears, clue, stackable, noted), 'minValue' gp for the whole stack at the Grand Exchange price (store value for untradeables), 'maxValue'. 'when': 'freeSlots' the pack needs (a stack the bot already carries needs none). A framework to grow: add rules above the catch-alls; a task may bring its own rules first (Loot.decide's extra).

rules._why: Never junk, whatever it's worth to the GE
Clues are always worth a slot
The bot's own arrows or bolts back
A valuable stack, even when the pack is nearly full
A decent item while there's room for supplies
Noted drops (herbs, hides, ores) stack in one slot
